Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. (claude.ai sync)","argumentHint":"","aliases":["docs"]},{"name":"anthropic-skills:docx","description":"Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx) or Word templates (.dotx). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file (to download, email or print), use this skill. However, if they ask for a document, page, report, memo, or notes WITHOUT naming a file format and the session offers Claude's own dedicated document or page skill or connector, use that instead. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or coding unrelated to document generation. (claude.ai sync)","argumentHint":"","aliases":["docx"]},{"name":"anthropic-skills:import-memory","description":"Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory — conversationally, additively, and with the content treated as data. (claude.ai sync)","argumentHint":"","aliases":["pdf"]},{"name":"anthropic-skills:pptx","description":"Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. resolve\n46\t   * the token by UNION-ALL across all tenant schemas. keyToken is a 256-bit\n47\t   * crypto-random value, so a cross-schema collision is not a practical concern\n48\t   * for the LIMIT 1 resolution.\n49\t   *\n50\t   * SENSOR-MEDIUM-001: `key_token` is stored as the SHA-256 hex digest, so the\n51\t   * lookup matches on `sha256(providedToken)` — the raw token is never in the\n52\t   * database and the query still hits the existing unique index on the digest.\n53\t   */\n54\t  private async findKeyAcrossSchemas(tokenHash: string): Promise<TenantProvisioningKey | null> {\n55\t    const schemas: { schema_name: string }[] = await this.dataSource.query(\n56\t      `SELECT schema_name FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name ~ '^tenant_[a-f0-9]{16}$'`,\n57\t    );\n58\t    if (schemas.length === 0) {\n59\t      return null;\n60\t    }\n61\t    // Schema names are constrained by the regex above (tenant_ + 16 hex chars).\n62\t    const unionParts = schemas.map(\n63\t non-replayable while fitting the existing\n77\t   * `varchar(64)` column (SHA-256 hex = 64 chars).\n78\t   */\n79\t  private hashToken(token: string): string {\n80\t    return key.updatedAt = new Date(row['updated_at'] as string);\n98\t    return key;\n99\t  }\n100\t\n101\t  /**\n102\t   * Create a tenant-level provisioning key\n103\t   * Allows multiple devices to expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + input.expiresInDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n115\t    }\n116\t\n117\t    const key = this.tenantKeyRepository.create({\n118\t      tenantId,\n119\t      keyToken: }\n187\t\n188\t    // Constant-time comparison over the fixed-width digests (both 32 bytes),\n189\t    // defeating any timing oracle on the resolved row.\n190\t    const storedBuf = }\n210\t\n211\t    return key;\n212\t  }\n213\t\n214\t  /**\n215\t   * Atomically increment the used_count for a tenant provisioning key.\n216\t   * If maxDevices is set, only increments if used_count * as crypto from 'crypto';\n\nimport {\n  Injectable,\n  Logger,\n  NotFoundException,\n  BadRequestException,\n  UnauthorizedException,\n  ConflictException,\n} from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';\nimport { Repository, EntityManager, DataSource } from 'typeorm';\n\nimport {\n  CreateTenantKeyInput,\n  TenantKeyResponse,\n} from './dto/provisioning.dto';\nimport { TenantProvisioningKey } from './entities/tenant-provisioning-key.entity';\nimport { InstallerScriptService } from './installer-script.service';\n\n/**\n * Tenant Key Service\n * Manages tenant-level provisioning keys that allow multiple devices\n * to self-register with a single installer link.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class TenantKeyService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(TenantKeyService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    @InjectRepository(TenantProvisioningKey)\n    private readonly tenantKeyRepository: Repository<TenantProvisioningKey>,\n    private readonly installerScriptService: InstallerScriptService,\n    private readonly dataSource: DataSource,\n  ) {}\n\n  /**\n   * SENSOR-HIGH-027: tenant_provisioning_keys is a per-tenant table, so keys\n   * created by the authenticated admin path land in `tenant_<uuid>`. But\n   * validateAndGetKey is reached from PUBLIC endpoints (self-register /\n   * installer) whose search_path defaults to \"sensor, public\", so a plain\n   * repository lookup queried the empty source-schema template and every\n   * legitimate token failed as \"Invalid installer token\".\n   *\n   * This mirrors the sibling `findDeviceAcrossSchemas` (edge_devices): resolve\n   * the token by UNION-ALL across all tenant schemas. keyToken is a 256-bit\n   * crypto-random value, so a cross-schema collision is not a practical concern\n   * for the LIMIT 1 resolution.\n   *\n   * SENSOR-MEDIUM-001: `key_token` is stored as the SHA-256 hex digest, so the\n   * lookup matches on `sha256(providedToken)` — the raw token is never in the\n   * database and the query still hits the existing unique index on the digest.\n   */\n  private async findKeyAcrossSchemas(tokenHash: string): Promise<TenantProvisioningKey | null> {\n    const schemas: { schema_name: string }[] = await this.dataSource.query(\n      `SELECT schema_name FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name ~ '^tenant_[a-f0-9]{16}$'`,\n    );\n    if (schemas.length === 0) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    // Schema names are constrained by the regex above (tenant_ + 16 hex chars).\n    const unionParts = schemas.map(\n      (s) => `SELECT * FROM \"${s.schema_name}\".tenant_provisioning_keys WHERE key_token = $1`,\n    );\n    const sql = `(${unionParts.join(' UNION ALL ')}) LIMIT 1`;\n    const rows = await this.dataSource.query(sql, [tokenHash]);\n    if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return this.mapRowToKey(rows[0]);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * SENSOR-MEDIUM-001: hash a provisioning key for at-rest storage / lookup.\n   * The raw key is a 256-bit crypto-random value, so a plain SHA-256 is\n   * sufficient to make a DB leak non-replayable while fitting the existing\n   * `varchar(64)` column (SHA-256 hex = 64 chars).\n   */\n  private hashToken(token: string): string {\n    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');\n  }\n\n  private mapRowToKey(row: Record<string, unknown>): TenantProvisioningKey {\n    const key = new TenantProvisioningKey();\n    key.id = row['id'] as string;\n    key.tenantId = row['tenant_id'] as string;\n    key.keyToken = row['key_token'] as string;\n    key.name = (row['name'] as string) ?? undefined;\n    key.isActive = row['is_active'] as boolean;\n    key.maxDevices = (row['max_devices'] as number) ?? undefined;\n    key.usedCount = row['used_count'] as number;\n    key.autoApprove = row['auto_approve'] as boolean;\n    key.defaultSiteId = (row['default_site_id'] as string) ?? undefined;\n    key.expiresAt = row['expires_at'] ? new Date(row['expires_at'] as string) : undefined;\n    key.createdBy = (row['created_by'] as string) ?? undefined;\n    key.createdAt = new Date(row['created_at'] as string);\n    key.updatedAt = new Date(row['updated_at'] as string);\n    return key;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Create a tenant-level provisioning key\n   * Allows multiple devices to self-register with a single installer link\n   */\n  async createTenantKey(\n    tenantId: string,\n    input: CreateTenantKeyInput,\n    createdBy: string,\n  ): Promise<TenantKeyResponse> {\n    const keyToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');\n\n    let expiresAt: Date | undefined;\n    if (input.expiresInDays) {\n      expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + input.expiresInDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n    }\n\n    const key = this.tenantKeyRepository.create({\n      tenantId,\n      keyToken: this.hashToken(keyToken),\n      name: input.name,\n      isActive: true,\n      maxDevices: input.maxDevices,\n      usedCount: 0,\n      autoApprove: input.autoApprove ?? false,\n      defaultSiteId: input.defaultSiteId,\n      expiresAt,\n      createdBy,\n    });\n\n    const saved = await this.tenantKeyRepository.save(key);\n    this.logger.log(`Created tenant provisioning key ${saved.id} for tenant ${tenantId}`);\n\n    // Surface the PLAINTEXT key exactly once. `saved.keyToken` is the digest at\n    // rest; the installer link and the one-time response carry the raw value.\n    return {\n      id: saved.id,\n      keyToken,\n      installerUrl: await this.installerScriptService.buildTenantInstallerUrl(),\n      installerCommand: await this.installerScriptService.buildTenantInstallerCommand(keyToken),\n      expiresAt: saved.expiresAt,\n      maxDevices: saved.maxDevices,\n      autoApprove: saved.autoApprove,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Revoke a tenant provisioning key\n   */\n  async revokeTenantKey(keyId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<boolean> {\n    const key = await this.tenantKeyRepository.findOne({\n      where: { id: keyId, tenantId },\n    });\n\n    if (!key) {\n      throw new NotFoundException(`Provisioning key ${keyId} not found`);\n    }\n\n    await this.tenantKeyRepository.update(key.id, { isActive: false });\n    key.isActive = false;\n    this.logger.log(`Revoked tenant provisioning key ${keyId}`);\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * List all provisioning keys for a tenant\n   */\n  async listTenantKeys(tenantId: string): Promise<TenantProvisioningKey[]> {\n    return this.tenantKeyRepository.find({\n      where: { tenantId },\n      order: { createdAt: 'DESC' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Validate a tenant provisioning key token and return the key if valid.\n   * Throws appropriate HTTP exceptions if the key is invalid, revoked, expired, or at capacity.\n   */\n  async validateAndGetKey(token: string): Promise<TenantProvisioningKey> {\n    // SENSOR-MEDIUM-001: the column stores sha256(rawKey); resolve by digest.\n    const tokenHash = this.hashToken(token);\n    // SENSOR-HIGH-027: resolve across tenant schemas (see findKeyAcrossSchemas).\n    const key = await this.findKeyAcrossSchemas(tokenHash);\n\n    if (!key) {\n      throw new NotFoundException('Invalid installer token');\n    }\n\n    // Constant-time comparison over the fixed-width digests (both 32 bytes),\n    // defeating any timing oracle on the resolved row.\n    const storedBuf = Buffer.from(key.keyToken, 'hex');\n    const inboundBuf = Buffer.from(tokenHash, 'hex');\n    if (\n      storedBuf.length !== inboundBuf.length ||\n      !crypto.timingSafeEqual(storedBuf, inboundBuf)\n    ) {\n      throw new NotFoundException('Invalid installer token');\n    }\n\n    if (!key.isActive) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('This installer key has been revoked');\n    }\n\n    if (key.expiresAt && key.expiresAt < new Date()) {\n      throw new UnauthorizedException('This installer key has expired');\n    }\n\n    if (key.maxDevices && key.usedCount >= key.maxDevices) {\n      throw new ConflictException('Maximum device limit reached for this key');\n    }\n\n    return key;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Atomically increment the used_count for a tenant provisioning key.\n   * If maxDevices is set, only increments if used_count < max_devices (prevents TOCTOU race).\n   * Throws ConflictException if the limit has been reached.\n   */\n  async incrementUsedCount(\n    keyId: string,\n    maxDevices: number | null | undefined,\n    transactionalManager: EntityManager,\n  ): Promise<void> {\n    if (maxDevices) {\n      const result = await transactionalManager\n        .createQueryBuilder()\n        .update(TenantProvisioningKey)\n        .set({ usedCount: () => '\"used_count\" + 1' })\n        .where('id = :id AND (\"max_devices\" IS NULL OR \"used_count\" < \"max_devices\")', { id: keyId })\n        .execute();\n\n      if (result.affected === 0) {\n        throw new ConflictException('Maximum device limit reached for this key');\n      }\n    } else {\n      await transactionalManager\n        .createQueryBuilder()\n        .update(TenantProvisioningKey)\n        .set({ usedCount: () => '\"used_count\" + 1' })\n        .where('id = :id', { id: keyId })\n        .execute();\n    }\n  }\n}\n","numLines":245,"startLine":1,"totalLines":245}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_014H1krWDAzBt6CZ45YvMv6S","type":"tool_result","content":"742\tdef generate_ai_consensus(\n743\t    *,\n744\t    tool_id: str,\n745\t    cycle_id: str | None = None,\n746\t    min_confidence: float = CONSENSUS_MIN_CONFIDENCE,\n747\t    workspace_root: str | Path | None = None,\n748\t    base_dir: str | Path | None = None,\n749\t    judge_weights: dict[str, float] | None = None,\n750\t    conformal_floor: float | None = None,\n751\t) -> dict[str, Any]:\n752\t    \"\"\"Kalibre Zekâ Z2a/Z2c — both knobs default OFF, preserving the\n753\t    legacy gate bit for bit:\n754\t\n755\t    * ``judge_weights`` (judge_id -> Beta-posterior precision mean, from\n756\t      ``calibrated_intelligence.judge_weights_from_calibration``): the\n757\t      unanimity requirement becomes a WEIGHTED vote — the winning verdict\n758\t      must carry a strict majority of total weight AND every dissenter's\n759\t      weight share stays under the margin; with two equal judges a single\n760\t      dissenter still escalates, exactly like unanimity, so behaviour only\n761\t      shifts when the fleet grows or posteriors genuinely separate.\n762\t    * ``conformal_floor`` (from ``conformal_threshold`` over past CORRECT\n763\t      consensus confidences): a passing consensus whose confidence falls\n764\t      below the floor abstains to a human (``conformal_abstain``) with the\n765\t      distribution-free guarantee that at most ~alpha of genuinely-correct\n766\t      consensuses are escalated.\n767\t    \"\"\"\n768\t    if min_confidence < 0 or min_confidence > 1:\n769\t        raise GovernanceError(\"min_confidence must be between 0 and 1\")\n770\t    ai_rows = [\n771\t        row\n772\t        for row in load_feedback(tool_id=tool_id, base_dir=base_dir)\n773\t        if row.get(\"source_type\") == \"ai_judge\" and (cycle_id is None or _feedback_cycle(row, base_dir) == cycle_id)\n774\t    ]\n775\t    # JJ-1 - the dedup key remembers HOW MANY judges VOTED on the settled row.\n776\t    # A group settled at 2 judges must be re-settleable once the anchor\n777\t    # arbiter answers, otherwise the 3rd judge's verdict is minted, paid for,\n778\t    # and then discarded by an idempotency guard - the anchor class would be\n779\t    # unreachable by construction. Attendance (not agreement) is the right\n780\t    # key: a third judge who DISAGREES leaves the agreement count at 2, and\n781\t    # keying on agreement would re-settle that group every cycle forever.\n782\t    # Re-running with no new judge still appends nothing, and the count is\n783\t    # bounded by the number of distinct judges.\n784\t    existing_consensus: dict[tuple[str, str, str], int] = {}\n785\t    for row in load_feedback(tool_id=tool_id, base_dir=base_dir):\n786\t        if row.get(\"source_type\") != \"ai_consensus\":\n787\t            continue\n788\t        key = _judgment_key(row)\n789\t        existing_consensus[key] = max(\n790\t            existing_consensus.get(key, 0), consensus_judges_voted(row),\n791\t        )\n792\t    grouped: dict[tuple[str, str, str], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = {}\n793\t    for row in ai_rows:\n794\t        run_id = str(row.get(\"run_id\") or \"\")\n795\t        finding_id = str(row.get(\"finding_id\") or \"\")\n796\t        group_id = str(row.get(\"judgment_group_id\") or \"\")\n797\t        judge_id = str(row.get(\"judge_id\") or \"\")\n798\t        if not run_id or not finding_id or not judge_id:\n799\t            continue\n800\t        grouped.setdefault((run_id, finding_id, group_id), {})[judge_id] = row\n801\t\n802\t    consensus_rows = []\n803\t    uncertainties = []\n804\t    for key, by_judge in sorted(grouped.items()):\n805\t        rows = list(by_judge.values())\n806\t        run_id, finding_id, group_id = key\n807\t        if key in existing_consensus and existing_consensus[key] >= len(rows):\n808\t            continue\n809\t        if len(rows) < 2:\n810\t            uncertainties.append(_consensus_uncertainty(tool_id, run_id, finding_id, group_id, \"single_judge\"))\n811\t            continue\n812\t        verdicts = {str(row.get(\"verdict\") or \"\") for row in rows}\n813\t        if judge_weights is None:\n814\t            if len(verdicts) != 1:\n815\t                uncertainties.append(_consensus_uncertainty(tool_id, run_id, finding_id, group_id, \"judge_disagreement\"))\n816\t                continue\n817\t        else:\n818\t            # Z2a — weighted vote. Weight-by-verdict; unknown judges weigh\n819\t            # at the neutral prior mean so a new judge neither dominates\n820\t            # nor vanishes. Strict-majority + margin: the winner needs\n821\t            # > 0.5 + margin of total weight, which with two equal judges\n822\t            # degenerates to unanimity — the legacy guarantee survives.\n823\t            _prior_mean = 0.8\n824\t            _margin = 0.10\n825\t            by_verdict: dict[str, float] = {}\n826\t            for judge_id, row in by_judge.items():\n827\t                weight = float(judge_weights.get(judge_id, _prior_mean))\n828\t                by_verdict[str(row.get(\"verdict\") or \"\")] = by_verdict.get(str(row.get(\"verdict\") or \"\"), 0.0) + weight\n829\t            total_weight = sum(by_verdict.values()) or 1.0\n830\t            winner, winner_weight = max(by_verdict.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])\n831\t            if winner_weight / total_weight <= 0.5 + _margin:\n832\t                uncertainties.append(_consensus_uncertainty(tool_id, run_id, finding_id, group_id, \"judge_disagreement\"))\n833\t                continue\n834\t            verdicts = {winner}\n835\t        # JJ-1 fix — from here the row speaks for the judges who AGREED with\n836\t        # the settled verdict. Everything the consensus row asserts about\n837\t        # itself (how many judges, at what confidence, on what evidence) is\n838\t        # scoped to them: a dissenter's confidence has no business raising\n839\t        # the mean of a verdict he refused, and his count has no business\n840\t        # buying the row its anchor grade.\n841\t        settled_verdict = next(iter(verdicts))\n842\t        agreeing = [\n843\t            row for row in rows\n844\t            if str(row.get(\"verdict\") or \"\") == settled_verdict\n845\t        ]\n846\t        # Kalibre Zekâ Z2b — a judge whose bridge stored confidence=None used\n847\t        # to be coerced to 0.0, silently dragging the mean under the 0.80\n848\t        # gate: a unanimous, correct pair could escalate as \"low_confidence\"\n849\t        # because one row lacked a number. Absent confidence now stays out of\n850\t        # the mean; a group with NO numeric confidence at all escalates under\n851\t        # its own name instead of masquerading as low confidence.\n852\t        confidences = [\n853\t            gated for row in agreeing\n854\t            if (gated := confidence_in_unit_interval(row.get(\"confidence\"))) is not None\n855\t        ]\n856\t        if not confidences:\n857\t            uncertainties.append(_consensus_uncertainty(tool_id, run_id, finding_id, group_id, \"missing_confidence\"))\n858\t            continue\n859\t        avg_confidence = sum(confidences) / len(confidences)\n860\t        if avg_confidence < min_confidence:\n861\t            uncertainties.append(_consensus_uncertainty(tool_id, run_id, finding_id, group_id, \"low_confidence\"))\n862\t            continue\n863\t        # Z2c — conformal abstention: below the calibrated floor, a\n864\t        # passing consensus still routes to a human. The floor is None on\n865\t        # a short window, so this gate never fires before evidence exists.\n866\t        if conformal_floor is not None and avg_confidence < conformal_floor:\n867\t            uncertainties.append(_consensus_uncertainty(tool_id, run_id, finding_id, group_id, \"conformal_abstain\"))\n868\t            continue\n869\t        # Plan 024 §C — evidence-gated arbiter. When a workspace is supplied, the\n870\t        # union of judge evidence is only published as consensus if it actually\n871\t        # resolves in the repo; a judge citing fabricated evidence escalates to a\n872\t        # human instead of being rubber-stamped. Opt-in: legacy callers without\n873\t        # workspace_root keep the pure mechanical gate.\n874\t        if workspace_root is not None and _has_unverifiable_evidence(rows, workspace_root):\n875\t            uncertainties.append(_consensus_uncertainty(tool_id, run_id, finding_id, group_id, \"evidence_not_repo_verified\"))\n876\t            continue\n877\t        dissenting = len(rows) - len(agreeing)\n878\t        severity = _max_severity(str(row.get(\"severity\") or \"medium\") for row in agreeing)\n879\t        note = f\"AI consensus from {len(agreeing)} independent judges\"\n880\t        if dissenting:\n881\t            note += ("}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"85b3d311-f96a-435e-baa3-85dcab9bdf55","uuid":"1e4d5877-d627-4586-8f95-eb404952b84e","timestamp":"2026-09-19T22:27:05.474Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-evidence-judge-0b4ad3927beb/aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py","content":"def generate_ai_consensus(\n    *,\n    tool_id: str,\n    cycle_id: str | None = None,\n    min_confidence: float = CONSENSUS_MIN_CONFIDENCE,\n    workspace_root: str | Path | None = None,\n    base_dir: str | Path | None = None,\n    judge_weights: dict[str, float] | None = None,\n    conformal_floor: float | None = None,\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Kalibre Zekâ Z2a/Z2c — both knobs default OFF, preserving the\n    legacy gate bit for bit:\n\n    * ``judge_weights`` (judge_id -> Beta-posterior precision mean, from\n      ``calibrated_intelligence.judge_weights_from_calibration``): the\n      unanimity requirement becomes a WEIGHTED vote — the winning verdict\n      must carry a strict majority of total weight AND every dissenter's\n      weight share stays under the margin; Attendance (not agreement) is the right\n    # key: a third judge who DISAGREES leaves the agreement count at 2, and\n    # keying on agreement would re-settle that group every cycle forever.\n    # Re-running with no new judge still appends nothing, and the count is\n    # bounded by the number of distinct judges.\n    existing_consensus: dict[tuple[str, str, str], int] = {}\n    for row in load_feedback(tool_id=tool_id, base_dir=base_dir):\n        if row.get(\"source_type\") != \"ai_consensus\":\n            continue\n        key = _judgment_key(row)\n        existing_consensus[key] = max(\n            existing_consensus.get(key, 0), consensus_judges_voted(row),\n        )\n    grouped: dict[tuple[str, str, str], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = {}\n    for row in ai_rows:\n        run_id = str(row.get(\"run_id\") or \"\")\n        finding_id = str(row.get(\"finding_id\") or \"\")\n        group_id = str(row.get(\"judgment_group_id\") or \"\")\n        judge_id = str(row.get(\"judge_id\") or \"\")\n        if not run_id or not finding_id or not judge_id:\n            continue\n        grouped.setdefault((run_id, finding_id, group_id), {})[judge_id] = row\n\n    consensus_rows = []\n    uncertainties = []\n    for key, by_judge in sorted(grouped.items()):\n        rows = list(by_judge.values())\n        run_id, finding_id, group_id = key\n        if key in existing_consensus and existing_consensus[key] >= len(rows):\n            continue\n        if len(rows) < 2:\n            uncertainties.append(_consensus_uncertainty(tool_id, run_id, finding_id, group_id, \"single_judge\"))\n            continue\n        verdicts = {str(row.get(\"verdict\") or \"\") for row in rows}\n        if judge_weights is None:\n            if len(verdicts) != 1:\n                uncertainties.append(_consensus_uncertainty(tool_id, run_id, finding_id, group_id, \"judge_disagreement\"))\n                continue\n        else:\n            # Z2a — weighted vote. Weight-by-verdict; unknown judges weigh\n            # at the neutral prior mean so a new judge neither dominates\n            # nor vanishes. Strict-majority + margin: the winner needs\n            # > 0.5 + margin of total weight, which with two equal judges\n            # degenerates to unanimity — the legacy guarantee survives.\n            _prior_mean = 0.8\n            _margin = 0.10\n            by_verdict: dict[str, float] = {}\n            for judge_id, row in by_judge.items():\n                weight = float(judge_weights.get(judge_id, _prior_mean))\n                by_verdict[str(row.get(\"verdict\") or \"\")] = by_verdict.get(str(row.get(\"verdict\") or \"\"), 0.0) + weight\n            total_weight = sum(by_verdict.values()) or 1.0\n            winner, winner_weight = max(by_verdict.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])\n            if winner_weight / total_weight <= 0.5 + _margin:\n                uncertainties.append(_consensus_uncertainty(tool_id, run_id, finding_id, group_id, \"judge_disagreement\"))\n                continue\n            verdicts = {winner}\n        # JJ-1 fix — from here the row speaks for the judges who AGREED with\n        # the settled verdict. Everything the consensus row asserts about\n        # itself (how many judges, at what confidence, on what evidence) is\n        # scoped to them: a dissenter's confidence has no business raising\n        # the mean of a verdict he refused, and his count has no business\n        # buying the row its anchor grade.\n        settled_verdict = next(iter(verdicts))\n        agreeing = [\n            row for row in rows\n            if str(row.get(\"verdict\") or \"\") == settled_verdict\n        ]\n        # Kalibre Zekâ Z2b — a judge whose bridge stored confidence=None used\n        # to be coerced to 0.0, silently dragging the mean under the 0.80\n        # gate: a unanimous, correct pair could escalate as \"low_confidence\"\n        # because one row lacked a number. Absent confidence now stays out of\n        # the mean; a group with NO numeric confidence at all escalates under\n        # its own name instead of masquerading as low confidence.\n        confidences = [\n            gated for row in agreeing\n            if (gated := confidence_in_unit_interval(row.get(\"confidence\"))) is not None\n        ]\n        if not confidences:\n            uncertainties.append(_consensus_uncertainty(tool_id, run_id, finding_id, group_id, \"missing_confidence\"))\n            continue\n        avg_confidence = sum(confidences) / len(confidences)\n        if avg_confidence < min_confidence:\n            uncertainties.append(_consensus_uncertainty(tool_id, run_id, finding_id, group_id, \"low_confidence\"))\n            continue\n        # Z2c — conformal abstention: below the calibrated floor, a\n        # passing consensus still routes to a human. The floor is None on\n        # a short window, so this gate never fires before evidence exists.\n        if conformal_floor is not None and avg_confidence < conformal_floor:\n            uncertainties.append(_consensus_uncertainty(tool_id, run_id, finding_id, group_id, \"conformal_abstain\"))\n            continue\n        # Plan 024 §C — evidence-gated arbiter. When a workspace is supplied, the\n        # union of judge evidence is only published as consensus if it actually\n        # resolves in the repo; a judge citing fabricated evidence escalates to a\n        # human instead of being rubber-stamped. Opt-in: legacy callers without\n        # workspace_root keep the pure mechanical gate.\n        if workspace_root is not None and _has_unverifiable_evidence(rows, workspace_root):\n            uncertainties.append(_consensus_uncertainty(tool_id, run_id, finding_id, group_id, \"evidence_not_repo_verified\"))\n            continue\n        dissenting = len(rows) - len(agreeing)\n        severity = _max_severity(str(row.get(\"severity\") or \"medium\") for row in agreeing)\n        note = f\"AI consensus from {len(agreeing)} independent judges\"\n        if dissenting:\n            note += (","numLines":140,"startLine":742,"totalLines":1594}}}

agent envelope\n    may use uppercase per finding schema. Normalize without rejecting.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(value, str):\n        return fallback\n    normalized = value.strip().lower()\n    if normalized in FEEDBACK_SEVERITIES:\n        return normalized\n    if normalized == \"informational\":\n        return \"low\"\n    return fallback\n\n\ndef _verdict_field(details: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"The judge .md prompts shape verdicts under details.verdict (evidence,\n    adversarial) or details.consensus (arbiter). Return whichever exists.\n    \"\"\"\n    if isinstance(details.get(\"verdict\"), dict):\n        return dict(details[\"verdict\"])\n    if isinstance(details.get(\"consensus\"), dict):\n        return dict(details[\"consensus\"])\n    if isinstance(details.get(\"verdict\"), str):\n        # Flat shape (ORPHAN-HIGH-629 sibling): the judge contract file says\n        # BOTH \"Return JSON with: verdict, judge_id, confidence...\" and\n        # \"details.verdict.rationale\". The first live judge run answered\n        # flat, was ACCEPTED by the envelope gate, and dropped HERE with\n        # \"expected verdict ..., got None\" — a verdict lost between two\n        # halves of one document. Honour both spellings; the envelope gate\n        # stays the only authority on validity.\n        return {\n            key: details.get(key)\n            for key in (\n                \"verdict\", \"tool_id\", \"run_id\", \"finding_id\", \"judge_id\",\n                \"model\", \"prompt_hash\", \"confidence\", \"rationale\",\n                \"evidence_refs\", \"judgment_group_id\", \"severity\",\n            )\n            if details.get(key) is not None\n        }\n    return {}\n\n\ndef validate_judge_response(\n    *,\n    request: dict[str, Any],\n    response: dict[str, Any],\n) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Y5 (ORPHAN-706) — the judge output contract, checkable BEFORE accept.\n\n    The second sealed night accepted 12 judge results whose envelopes never\n    carried a verdict the bridge could read (\"expected verdict ..., got\n    None\") — each one an accepted row that could never fold, burning bridge\n    retries toward permanent_fail. This is the SINGLE definition of what a\n    judge response must carry; ``record_judge_verdict_from_response`` raises\n    on exactly this list, and the executor's pre-submit gate releases the\n    claim on it instead of sealing an unfoldable result.\n\n    Returns [] for non-judge roles: the contract binds judges only.\n    \"\"\"\n    role = response.get(\"role\")\n    if not is_judge_role(role):\n        return []\n    errors: list[str] = []\n    details = response.get(\"details\") or {}\n    if not isinstance(details, dict):\n        details = {}\n    verdict_block = _verdict_field(details)\n    if not verdict_block:\n        return [\"judge_verdict:absent\"]\n    verdict = verdict_block.get(\"verdict\")\n    if verdict not in FEEDBACK_VERDICTS:\n        # ORPHAN-CRITICAL-735 — the arbiter's contract says \"return\n        # details.consensus, OR the uncertainty reason when the consensus\n        # gate cannot be met\", and the deterministic engine it mirrors\n        # emits exactly that non-verdict outcome. The live arbiter obeyed\n        # and this contract burned the claim as invalid:None — fourth\n        # mint-vs-law instance. Uncertainty is a VALID arbitration\n        # outcome, for the arbiter alone, with a reason from the closed\n        # vocabulary; binary judges stay bound to binary verdicts.\n        reason = verdict_block.get(\"uncertainty_reason\")\n        if (\n            role == \"consensus_arbitration\"\n            and verdict is None\n            and reason in CONSENSUS_UNCERTAINTY_REASONS\n        ):\n            pass\n        else:\n            errors.append(f\"judge_verdict.verdict:invalid:{verdict!r}\")\n    tool_id = request.get(\"tool_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"tool_id\")\n    run_id = request.get(\"run_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"run_id\")\n    finding_id = request.get(\"finding_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"finding_id\")\n    if not (tool_id and run_id and finding_id):\n        errors.append(\"judge_verdict:missing_tool_run_or_finding_id\")\n    judge_id = details.get(\"agent_subagent_type\") or verdict_block.get(\"judge_id\")\n    if not judge_id:\n        errors.append(\"judge_verdict:missing_judge_identity\")\n    elif str(judge_id).startswith(\"ci-executor:\"):\n        errors.append(\"judge_verdict:executor_shaped_judge_identity\")\n    return errors\n\n\ndef record_judge_verdict_from_response(\n    *,\n    request: dict[str, Any],\n    response: dict[str, Any],\n    base_dir: str | Path | None = None,\n) -> dict[str, Any] | None:\n    \"\"\"Translate an ACCEPTED judge response into an ai_judge feedback row.\n\n    Returns the persisted row, or None when the envelope role is not a\n    judge role (the bridge is a no-op for non-judge submissions).\n\n    Raises GovernanceError when the response is missing the data the\n    consensus engine requires (tool_id / run_id / finding_id come from\n    the request envelope's optional fields; verdict + severity from\n    the response.details).\n    \"\"\"\n    role = response.get(\"role\")\n    if not is_judge_role(role):\n        return None\n\n    # Y5 (ORPHAN-706) — one contract, two consumers: the executor's\n    # pre-submit gate checks exactly this list and releases instead of\n    # sealing an unfoldable accepted result; the bridge raises on it so a\n    # row that somehow slipped past still fails loudly, never half-folds.\n    contract_errors = validate_judge_response(request=request, response=response)\n    if contract_errors:\n        raise GovernanceError(\n            \"judge bridge contract violation: \" + \"; \".join(contract_errors)\n        )\n\n    details = response.get(\"details\") or {}\n    if not isinstance(details, dict):\n        details = {}\n\n    # ORPHAN-CRITICAL-735 — the arbiter's legitimate non-verdict outcome\n    # folds through the SAME producer, ledger and idempotent escalation_id\n    # as the deterministic engine, so one sweep drains both lanes into one\n    # HUMAN_REQUIRED record. It is NOT a feedback verdict: an uncertain\n    # arbitration must never write an ai_judge row.\n    if role == \"consensus_arbitration\":\n        arb_block = _verdict_field(details)\n        arb_reason = arb_block.get(\"uncertainty_reason\")\n        if arb_block.get(\"verdict\") is None and arb_reason in CONSENSUS_UNCERTAINTY_REASONS:\n            from .feedback_store import record_consensus_uncertainty\n\n            row = record_consensus_uncertainty(\n                tool_id=str(request.get(\"tool_id\") or arb_block.get(\"tool_id\") or \"\"),\n                run_id=str(request.get(\"run_id\") or arb_block.get(\"run_id\") or \"\"),\n                finding_id=str(request.get(\"finding_id\") or arb_block.get(\"finding_id\") or \"\"),\n                group_id=str(request.get(\"judgment_group_id\") or arb_block.get(\"group_id\") or \"\"),\n                reason=str(arb_reason),\n                cycle_id=request.get(\"cycle_id\"),\n                base_dir=base_dir,\n            )\n            return {\"kind\": \"consensus_uncertainty\", **row}\n    verdict_block = _verdict_field(details)\n\n    tool_id = request.get(\"tool_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"tool_id\")\n    run_id = request.get(\"run_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"run_id\")\n    finding_id = request.get(\"finding_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"finding_id\")\n    if not (tool_id and run_id and finding_id):\n        raise GovernanceError(\n            \"judge bridge requires tool_id, run_id, finding_id in request or response.details.verdict; \"\n            f\"got tool_id={tool_id!r}, run_id={run_id!r}, finding_id={finding_id!r}\"\n        )\n\n    verdict = verdict_block.get(\"verdict\")\n    if verdict not in FEEDBACK_VERDICTS:\n        raise GovernanceError(\n            f\"judge bridge expected verdict in {FEEDBACK_VERDICTS}, got {verdict!r}\"\n        )\n    severity = _coerce_severity(verdict_block.get(\"severity\") or details.get(\"severity\"))\n    # D1 (Kapalı Döngü) — judge identity. `response[\"agent_id\"]` is the\n    # EXECUTOR's identity (`ci-executor:gha-<run>`), not the judge's: reading\n    # it collapsed every judge drained by one workflow run into a single\n    # voter (consensus structurally impossible) while judges drained by\n    # DIFFERENT runs counted as distinct voters with meaningless identity.\n    # The judge's real identity is the subagent the executor invoked\n    # (`details.agent_subagent_type`, force-stamped by ci_executor); the\n    # mock lane and legacy envelopes carry it as `verdict.judge_id`.\n    judge_id = details.get(\"agent_subagent_type\") or verdict_block.get(\"judge_id\")\n    if not judge_id:\n        raise GovernanceError(\n            \"judge bridge requires details.agent_subagent_type \"\n            \"(or details.verdict.judge_id)\"\n        )\n    if str(judge_id).startswith(\"ci-executor:\"):\n        # Refuse loudly instead of silently repairing: an executor-shaped\n        # identity means the producer regressed, and a repaired row would","numLines":200,"startLine":40,"totalLines":388}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_012Mk42CGsV3MiEcUEGo6kpj","type":"tool_result","content":"484\tdef record_operator_feedback(\n485\t    *,\n486\t    tool_id: str,\n487\t    run_id: str,\n488\t    finding_id: str,\n489\t    verdict: str,\n490\t    severity: str,\n491\t    note: str,\n492\t    affected_belief_ids: list[str] | None = None,\n493\t    source_type: str = \"human\",\n494\t    judge_id: str | None = None,\n495\t    model: str | None = None,\n496\t    prompt_hash: str | None = None,\n497\t    confidence: float | None = None,\n498\t    rationale: str | None = None,\n499\t    evidence_refs: list[str] | None = None,\n500\t    judgment_group_id: str | None = None,\n501\t    finding_fingerprint: str | None = None,\n502\t    judge_count: int | None = None,\n503\t    judges_voted: int | None = None,\n504\t    judgment_subject: str = JUDGMENT_SUBJECT_FINDING,\n505\t    observers: list[dict[str, str]] | None = None,\n506\t    base_dir: str | Path | None = None,\n507\t) -> dict[str, Any]:\n508\t    if judgment_subject not in JUDGMENT_SUBJECTS:\n509\t        raise GovernanceError(f\"unknown judgment subject: {judgment_subject}\")\n510\t    if verdict not in FEEDBACK_VERDICTS:\n511\t        raise GovernanceError(f\"unknown feedback verdict: {verdict}\")\n512\t    if severity not in FEEDBACK_SEVERITIES:\n513\t        raise GovernanceError(f\"unknown feedback severity: {severity}\")\n514\t    if source_type not in FEEDBACK_SOURCE_TYPES:\n515\t        raise GovernanceError(f\"unknown feedback source_type: {source_type}\")\n516\t    if affected_belief_ids is not None and not _valid_string_list(affected_belief_ids):\n517\t        raise GovernanceError(\"affected_belief_ids must be an array of non-empty strings\")\n518\t    if evidence_refs is not None and not _valid_string_list(evidence_refs):\n519\t        raise GovernanceError(\"evidence_refs must be an array of non-empty strings\")\n520\t    # One gate for the whole number semantics: isinstance lets bool and\n521\t    # NaN through (nan < 0 and nan > 1 are both False), and those must be\n522\t    # refusals, not probabilities.\n523\t    if confidence is not None and confidence_in_unit_interval(confidence) is None:\n524\t        raise GovernanceError(\"confidence must be a finite number between 0 and 1\")\n525\t    if source_type != \"human\" and (not judge_id or not judge_id.strip()):\n526\t        raise GovernanceError(\"AI feedback requires judge_id\")\n527\t    for _name, _value in ((\"judge_count\", judge_count), (\"judges_voted\", judges_voted)):\n528\t        if _value is not None and (\n529\t            isinstance(_value, bool) or not isinstance(_value, int) or _value < 1\n530\t        ):\n531\t            raise GovernanceError(f\"{_name} must be a positive integer\")\n532\t    # JJ-1 (ORPHAN-HIGH-731) - Tier 1: a consensus row that cannot say how\n533\t    # many judges backed it is UNWRITABLE. A stitched\n    envelope from a different lease (same request_id but different\n    claim/agent) would pass.\n    \"\"\"\n    missing = [f for f in RESPONSE_REQUIRED_FIELDS if f not in envelope]\n    if missing:\n        raise GovernanceError(f\"agent-response missing required fields: {missing}\")\n    if envelope[\"$schema\"] != RESPONSE_SCHEMA:\n        raise GovernanceError(f\"agent-response $schema must be {RESPONSE_SCHEMA!r}\")\n    if not isinstance(envelope[\"request_id\"], str) or not REQUEST_ID_RE.match(envelope[\"request_id\"]):\n        raise GovernanceError(f\"agent-response.request_id invalid: {envelope['request_id']!r}\")\n    claim_id = envelope[\"claim_id\"]\n    if not isinstance(claim_id, str) or not CLAIM_ID_RE.match(claim_id):\n        raise GovernanceError(f\"agent-response.claim_id invalid: {claim_id!r}\")\n    agent_id = envelope[\"agent_id\"]\n    if not isinstance(agent_id, str) or not AGENT_ID_RE.match(agent_id):\n        raise GovernanceError(f\"agent-response.agent_id invalid: {agent_id!r}\")\n    role = envelope[\"role\"]\n    if role not in INVOCATION_ROLES:\n        raise GovernanceError(f\"agent-response.role unknown: {role!r}\")\n    status = envelope[\"status\"]\n    if status not in RESPONSE_STATUSES:\n        raise GovernanceError(f\"agent-response.status unknown: {status!r}\")\n\n    matrix = envelope[\"satisfaction_matrix\"]\n    if not isinstance(matrix, list):\n        raise GovernanceError(\"agent-response.satisfaction_matrix must be a list\")\n    matrix_entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    matrix_ids: set[str] = set()\n    for idx, entry in enumerate(matrix):\n        if not isinstance(entry, dict):\n            raise GovernanceError(f\"satisfaction_matrix[{idx}] must be an object\")\n        item_id = entry.get(\"id\")\n        verdict = entry.get(\"verdict\")\n        if not isinstance(item_id, str) or not item_id.strip():\n            raise GovernanceError(f\"satisfaction_matrix[{idx}].id is required\")\n        if item_id in matrix_ids:\n            raise GovernanceError(f\"satisfaction_matrix[{idx}].id duplicate: {item_id}\")\n        matrix_ids.add(item_id)\n        if verdict not in SATISFACTION_VERDICTS:\n            raise GovernanceError(\n                f\"satisfaction_matrix[{idx}].verdict {verdict!r} not in {SATISFACTION_VERDICTS}\"\n            )\n        if verdict in {\"blocked\", \"contradicted\"}:\n            note = entry.get(\"note\") or entry.get(\"rationale\") or \"\"\n            if not isinstance(note, str) or not note.strip():\n                raise GovernanceError(\n                    f\"satisfaction_matrix[{idx}].note required when verdict={verdict!r}\"\n                )\n            _check_banned_phrases(note, field=f\"satisfaction_matrix[{item_id}].note\")\n            evidence_refs = entry.get(\"evidence_refs\", [])\n            _ensure_string_list(\n                evidence_refs,\n                field=f\"satisfaction_matrix[{item_id}].evidence_refs\",\n                allow_empty=False,\n            )\n        matrix_entries.append(entry)\n\n    rationale = envelope.get(\"rationale\")\n    if isinstance(rationale, str) and rationale.strip():\n        _check_banned_phrases(rationale, field=\"agent-response.rationale\")\n\n    # Plan 023 v3 §A-5 — envelope differs. _belief_uncertainty_scores(base_dir: str | Path | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n    latest: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}\n    for row in load_jsonl(ensure_tools_dir(base_dir) / \"memory\" / \"beliefs.jsonl\"):\n        belief_id = str(row.get(\"belief_id\") or \"\")\n        if belief_id:\n            latest[belief_id] = row\n    scores = []\n    for belief_id, belief in latest.items():\n        refs = _optional_string_list(belief.get(\"evidence_refs\")) or _optional_string_list(belief.get(\"evidence\"))\n        if not refs:\n            continue\n        confidence = belief.get(\"confidence\", 1.0)\n        try:\n            confidence_float = float(confidence)\n        except (TypeError, ValueError):\n            confidence_float = 1.0\n        status = \"withdrawn\": 0.0,\n            \"supported\": 0.0,\n        }.get(status, 0.1)\n        uncertainty = max(0.0, min(1.0, 1.0 - confidence_float + status_boost))\n        if uncertainty <= 0:\n 0.0}.get(str(finding.get(\"severity\") or \"\").lower(), 0.0)\n    score = min(1.0, score + severity_boost)\n    for belief in belief_scores:\n        refs =
